answer: A bank of pre-written answers thus has nothing to key against, and filling 163 aliases means authoring 163 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the basalt signature, the karst gate rejects a mismatch, and the ivory checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 86 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
